review_text: Tried to transfer rent money and the app crashed mid-transaction. Had to call support to confirm it didn't double-send.
My advisor caught an allocation drift before it became a problem and rebalanced same week. This is why I stay with Meridian.
Was charged a foreign transaction fee on a purchase made in-state. Disputed it twice and still no resolution after three weeks.
Biometric login is fast and reliable now. Only wish the balance widget updated in real time instead of a five-minute lag.
Submitted my mortgage refinance documents twice because the upload silently failed both times with no error message.
Quarterly statements are clear but I still don't understand the fee breakdown on managed accounts. Needs a plain-language summary.
Fraud alert caught a stolen card use within minutes and the replacement card arrived in two days. Genuinely impressed.
App logs me out mid-transfer at least once a week. Losing trust that my transactions are actually going through correctly.
Rate lock process was smooth, but the countdown timer on the portal doesn't match what the loan officer told me over the phone.
Was on hold for 55 minutes to report a suspicious charge, then got disconnected and had to start over from zero.
Was moved to a new advisor without any notice. Found out only when my usual contact didn't respond to a scheduling email.
Check deposit via photo has never failed for me once in two years. Small thing but it saves me a trip every month.
Rewards program is fine but redeeming points for statement credit takes 7-10 business days, which feels outdated in 2026.
Was pre-approved for a HELOC, went through underwriting, then denied at closing over a document inconsistency nobody flagged earlier.
Budgeting tools are genuinely useful for tracking spend by category. Would love the ability to set custom category rules.
Called about a wire transfer question and the rep walked me through it patiently instead of rushing me off the phone. Rare these days.
Management fee increased by 0.3% with only a buried line in a PDF disclosure. No call, no email highlighting the change.
Autopay failed silently because my card on file expired, and I got hit with a late fee before any notification reached me.
App works fine on iOS but the Android version lags noticeably when switching between accounts. Been this way for months.
Refinanced our auto loan entirely online in under 20 minutes, funds hit the account the next business day. Couldn't be easier.
Chatbot couldn't understand a simple 'update my address' request and kept looping me back to the same three menu options.
Portfolio performance has been solid, but the client portal's charts are hard to read on mobile — bars overlap at smaller screen sizes.
Card was declined for a routine grocery purchase with no explanation, then approved an hour later for a larger amount. Confusing and embarrassing.
Instant peer-to-peer transfers between Meridian accounts are genuinely instant, not the fake 'instant' other banks advertise.
Application status tracker is helpful but doesn't explain what 'in review' actually means or how long that stage typically takes.
Escalated a billing dispute three times and got three different answers from three different reps. No case notes carried over.
Tax-loss harvesting suggestions from my advisor saved us real money this year. Proactive, not just reactive, advice.
Virtual card numbers for online shopping are a great security feature. Wish it was easier to find in the app menu.
Push notifications for large transactions arrive 10-15 minutes after the charge posts, which defeats the purpose of a fraud alert.
Interest rate quoted at application was 0.5% higher by closing with no clear explanation of why it changed.
Support rep was knowledgeable and resolved my dispute in one call, though the hold music genuinely needs to be shorter or muted by default.
Onboarding paperwork was extensive and repetitive — asked for the same identity verification documents four separate times.
Split-bill feature with friends who don't bank with Meridian actually works seamlessly through a simple link. Very well built.
Annual fee was charged before the promotional first-year waiver kicked in, and support said it would 'sort itself out' with no timeline.
Refinance calculator on the portal is accurate and easy to use. Only issue is it doesn't factor in current promotional rates automatically.
Reported a lost card at 11pm and had a temporary virtual card issued within minutes through the app. No wait, no hassle.
Robo-advisor rebalancing triggered a taxable event that could have been avoided with better timing. Felt automated, not personalized.
App requires re-authentication with a 2FA code every single login, even minutes apart, which makes quick balance checks tedious.
Dispute over a merchant double-charge was resolved in 48 hours with a temporary credit issued immediately. Exactly how it should work.
Overall a smooth process, but the portal doesn't clearly state which documents are still outstanding versus already received.
